description:
Cast View from Above by paying {2}, targeting Birgi.
Birgi and Veyran trigger twice.
Resolve the Birgi triggers, adding {2}.
Resolve the Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve View from Above, giving Birgi flying until end of turn and returning View from Above to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
